title: L3: Rhys start page and complete dated Codex guide index
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/signoff/START-HERE-RHYS.md as a short front page covering every day Wed 4–Thu 12 November, with PRs, named owners and plain actions. A linked supporting catalogue lists all 138 captured published Codex guide paths across docs/signoff, docs/runbooks, docs/iso9001 and tests, including historical guides/handovers and exact immutable links. New L1–L5 papers are linked separately.

Keeps #316's corrected masters, #314/#305 safety/source corrections, #315's distinct results and #322's qualified restrictions; avoids duplicate signing and distinguishes missing actual/private evidence from paperwork. Friday build/test deadline and conditional Thursday opening retained.

Validation: 138 unique guide paths, 140 immutable file links resolve in Git, nine dated groups and whitespace checked. Handover embedded in the catalogue. Documentation only; no runtime/physical-print fit or acceptance claimed, main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
